answer.verdict: Self-overlap drains the queue then draws that primitive on the submitter. T8/T4 page stride is the truncating PageId formula and the odd-TBW test locks it. CLAMP/REPEAT/REGION_CLAMP/REGION_REPEAT already mark the texels those modes read; ignoring the mode fails the new test. ~GSCpuBackend drops queued primitives, so docs/status.md:661 is true. On the matched arcade load the serial path did not add drains (sample 43.34/s with it, 46.38/s with it compiled out, wall s60-88). The pre-fix capture is the Tekken Force help screen.

facts.c: A primitive whose sampled pages intersect the frame or Z pages of that same primitive waits for the workers (DrainReason::SampleConflict), draws on the submitter (t_bandCount stays 1), bumps m_memoryStamp, and returns without queueing. Counted by g_gsSelfOverlapSerial.
GS_TakeSelfOverlapSerialDraws exchanges that counter to 0. The four-thread test requires 1 on each of two runs and byte-identical VRAM versus the no-worker draw.
MakePageRect stride is (bufferWidth*64)/pageWidth, truncating, same as PixelStorageTraits::PageId (bw*64)/page_extent.x. No max(1).
PagesCoveringTexel walks that rect modulo 512. The odd-TBW test requires T8 TBW=1 y=70 on the same page as y=0 and T4 TBW=3 y=128 to be base+1.
coverAxis handles REPEAT, CLAMP, REGION_CLAMP, and REGION_REPEAT (UMSK/UFIX as MIN/MAX). AppendSampledPages feeds it the UV span.

With coverAxis forced to mark the raw UV, ps2x_tests was 480/481 and the only failure was 'texture page marks follow REPEAT, CLAMP, REGION_CLAMP and REGION_REPEAT' (vram mismatch vs serial, both threaded runs). Restored coverAxis then 481/481.
cmd /c tools\build_tests.cmd after the restored sources: Total Tests 481, Passed 481, Failed 0.

~GSCpuBackend calls only StopWorkers. StopWorkers sets m_stopWorkers, notifies, and joins. It does not call WaitForWorkersUnlocked. WorkerLoop returns when m_stopWorkers is set, comment 'shutting down: queued primitives are dropped'.
docs/status.md says shutdown drops queued primitives (no drawing after GS memory is gone). That matches the destructor.

fix.change: On sampled-page overlap with this primitive's own frame or Z, WaitForWorkersUnlocked(SampleConflict), draw on the submitter, return. Reuses the sample drain column.
Stride left as floor (bufferWidth*64)/pageWidth. PagesCoveringTexel exposes the pages for the test.
coverAxis left as the four GS wrap modes. Test is the new lock.
Three tests: self-feedback sprite 4 threads == serial and serial-draw count == 1 twice; odd TBW PageId; five CLAMP modes keep the pre-upload texel across a queued upload.
